name: session-router
description: Routes each new session's first prompt to the right Claude model and effort, explains why, and lets you override before it is sent.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: default, shadow or auto. default asks before switching; shadow notes the pick without asking or switching; auto applies it without asking, in headless runs (claude -p) too.

style.title: Routing style
style.description: frugal, balanced or performance. Tiebreak when two options are close: frugal prefers the cheapest model that will finish, performance the more capable model.

excludeModels.title: Models to never recommend
excludeModels.description: Comma-separated families the router won't suggest, e.g. "fable" if you don't have access to it. You can still type one in the picker.

routerModel.title: Router model
routerModel.description: The model that makes the routing decision.

routerEffort.title: Router effort
routerEffort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. How hard the router thinks about the decision.

remoteMode.title: Remote Control prompts
remoteMode.description: ask, auto or skip. In default mode: ask shows the picker on the phone too; auto applies the pick without asking; skip leaves phone sessions unrouted (in auto mode too).

askIfSame.title: Ask even when the pick is the current setting
askIfSame.description: Default mode only. Off: when the pick is the current model at the current effort, send without asking.

bypassPrefix.title: Bypass prefix
bypassPrefix.description: Start a first prompt with this to skip routing (the prefix is removed). Avoid ! (shell mode) and / (commands).

timeoutMs.title: Router timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: After this, the prompt is sent on the current model.
